meta.scope: chromium/src branch main: merged, abandoned and open CLs; review comments by non-owner, non-bot accounts on human-owned CLs (bot-owned CLs are counted only in weekly_totals.csv)
meta.path_rule: a comment is placed on its file; a patchset-level comment on its CL's anchor (the file with the most inline comments); the longest matching path_rules prefix decides, and paths matching none are included; comments that can't be placed are excluded (see area_weekly.json)
meta.weeks_rule: comments and review_chars count in the ISO week the comment was written; reviewed_cls in the week the CL closed; reviewers = accounts credited with any of these that week; weekly_totals is by close week
meta.org_rule: affiliations.json5 (dated, as of the day written, or the CL's close for reviewed_cls) > other @chromium.org -> google.com > email domain
meta.metric_notes: comments include self-declared AI comments from a reviewer's own account (is_ai flag or autogenerated:* tag; that subset is ai_comments, a lower bound) and post-merge comments (that subset is post_merge_comments); review_chars exclude quoted '>' lines; reviewed_cls = closed CLs with an in-scope comment from the org; votes don't count
